Next.js 16.4

Next.js 16.4 includes improvements to the bundle analyzer and caching. Upgrade today with the command below. This release focuses on developer experience and build performance for large applications.

npx @next/codemod@canary upgrade latest
npm install next@latest

next analyze

The next analyze command is now stable. It shows which modules contribute to your bundle size, so you can find heavy dependencies quickly and keep your pages fast.

  • Works with Turbopack
  • Requires v16.4.0 or later

Breaking changes

The experimental.analyze option has been removed. Use the next analyze command instead. Projects on 16.3.6 need to update their scripts.
